specs.name: read_file
specs.description: Read a file and return its contents. Supports text files and images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, etc.). For text files you can optionally request a specific line range. Images are returned as binary so you can view and analyze them directly. Use display_file to show a file to the user.

path.description: Path to the file to read.

start_line.description: First line to return (1-indexed, inclusive). Defaults to the beginning of the file.

end_line.description: Last line to return (1-indexed, inclusive). Defaults to the end of the file.

specs.name: display_file
specs.description: Open a file in the user's file viewer so they can see it. Use this when the user wants to view or look at a file. This does not return file content to you — use read_file if you need to read the content yourself.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to display.

specs.name: write_file
specs.description: Write text content to a file. Creates parent directories automatically. Overwrites if the file already exists.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute or relative path to write to. Parent directories are created automatically.

content.title: Content
content.description: Text content to write to the file.
